source_caption:
Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery follows Austin Powers, a flamboyant British secret agent who is cryogenically frozen in the 1960s and revived in the 1990s to stop his arch-enemy, Dr. Evil. Adjusting to the modern world, Austin teams up with agent Vanessa Kensington to save the planet.

The film is a spy comedy that parodies James Bond movies, 1960s culture, and classic spy clichés. Directed by Jay Roach and written by Mike Myers, it stars Myers, Elizabeth Hurley, Michael York, Seth Green, and Robert Wagner.
